'''Sarini Island''' was an island located on the [[planet]] [[Chandrila]]. It featured a [[Sarini Island zoo|zoo]].<ref name="Life Debt" /> In [[5 ABY]],<ref name="Life Debt Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' to [[5 ABY]].</ref> [[Brentin Lore Wexley|Brentin]], [[Temmin Wexley|Temmin]], and [[Norra Wexley|Norra]] [[Wexley family|Wexley]] arrived in Sarini Island to visit its zoo. During their visit, they saw [[pangorin]]s in their grottoes, [[caw-crab]]s splashing around their enclosures, and [[uralang]]s, which Brentin laughed at.<ref name="Life Debt" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sarini Island was first mentioned in ''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'', a novel by [[Chuck Wendig]],<ref name="Life Debt" /> which was released on [[July 12]], [[2016]].<ref name="Penguin-eBook">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/531277/life-debt-aftermath-star-wars-by-chuck-wendig/9781101966945|text=Life Debt: Aftermath (Star Wars)}} {{C|eBook}}</ref>
